an8.55:1.1: ujjayo brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
an8.55:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho ujjayo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an8.55:1.4: tesanno bhavaṃ gotamo amhākaṃ tathā dhammaṃ desetu ye amhākaṃ assu dhammā diṭṭhadhammahitāya diṭṭhadhammasukhāya samparāyahitāya samparāyasukhāyāti.
an8.55:2.1: cattārome brāhmaṇa dhammā kulaputtassa diṭṭhadhammahitāya saṃvattanti diṭṭhadhammasukhāya.
an8.55:3.2: idha brāhmaṇa kulaputto yena kammuṭṭhānena jīvikaṃ kappeti
an8.55:3.3: yadi kasiyā yadi vaṇijjāya yadi gorakkhena yadi issatthena yadi rājaporisena yadi sippaññatarena
an8.55:3.4: tattha dakkho hoti analaso tatrupāyāya vīmaṃsāya samannāgato alaṃ kātuṃ alaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ
an8.55:4.2: idha brāhmaṇa kulaputtassa bhogā honti uṭṭhānaviriyādhigatā bāhābalaparicitā sedāvakkhittā dhammikā dhammaladdhā
an8.55:4.4: kinti me ime bhoge neva rājāno hareyyuṃ na corā hareyyuṃ na aggi ḍaheyya na udakaṃ vaheyya na appiyā dāyādā hareyyunti
an8.55:5.2: idha brāhmaṇa kulaputto yasmiṃ gāme vā nigame vā paṭivasati tatra ye te honti gahapati vā gahapatiputtā vā daharā vā vuḍḍhasīlino vuḍḍhā vā vuḍḍhasīlino saddhāsampannā sīlasampannā cāgasampannā paññāsampannā tehi saddhiṃ santiṭṭhati sallapati sākacchaṃ samāpajjati yathārūpānaṃ saddhāsampannānaṃ saddhāsampadaṃ anusikkhati yathārūpānaṃ sīlasampannānaṃ sīlasampadaṃ anusikkhati yathārūpānaṃ cāgasampannānaṃ cāgasampadaṃ anusikkhati yathārūpānaṃ paññāsampannānaṃ paññāsampadaṃ anusikkhati
an8.55:6.2: idha brāhmaṇa kulaputto āyañca bhogānaṃ viditvā vayañca bhogānaṃ viditvā samajīvikaṃ kappeti nāccogāḷhaṃ nātihīnaṃ evaṃ me āyo vayaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassati na ca me vayo āyaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatīti
an8.55:6.3: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇa tulādhāro vā tulādhārantevāsī vā tulaṃ paggahetvā jānāti ettakena vā onataṃ ettakena vā unnatanti
an8.55:6.4: evameva kho brāhmaṇa kulaputto āyañca bhogānaṃ viditvā vayañca bhogānaṃ viditvā samajīvikaṃ kappeti nāccogāḷhaṃ nātihīnaṃ evaṃ me āyo vayaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassati na ca me vayo āyaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatīti
an8.55:6.5: sacāyaṃ brāhmaṇa kulaputto appāyo samāno uḷāraṃ jīvikaṃ kappeti tassa bhavanti vattāro udumbarakhādakañcāyaṃ kulaputto bhoge khādatīti
an8.55:6.6: sace panāyaṃ brāhmaṇa kulaputto mahāyo samāno kasiraṃ jīvikaṃ kappeti tassa bhavanti vattāro addhamārakañcāyaṃ kulaputto marissatīti
an8.55:6.7: yato ca khoyaṃ brāhmaṇa kulaputto āyañca bhogānaṃ viditvā vayañca bhogānaṃ viditvā samajīvikaṃ kappeti nāccogāḷhaṃ nātihīnaṃ evaṃ me āyo vayaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassati na ca me vayo āyaṃ pariyādāya ṭhassatīti
an8.55:7.1: evaṃ samuppannānaṃ brāhmaṇa bhogānaṃ cattāri apāyamukhāni honti
an8.55:7.2: itthīdhutto surādhutto akkhadhutto pāpamitto pāpasahāyo pāpasampavaṅko
an8.55:7.3: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇa mahato taḷākassa cattāri ceva āyamukhāni cattāri ca apāyamukhāni tassa puriso yāni ceva āyamukhāni tāni pidaheyya yāni ca apāyamukhāni tāni vivareyya devo ca na sammā dhāraṃ anuppaveccheyya evañhi tassa brāhmaṇa mahato taḷākassa parihāni yeva pāṭikaṅkhā no vuḍḍhi
an8.55:7.4: evameva kho brāhmaṇa evaṃ samuppannānaṃ bhogānaṃ cattāri apāyamukhāni honti
an8.55:7.5: itthīdhutto surādhutto akkhadhutto pāpamitto pāpasahāyo pāpasampavaṅko.
an8.55:8.1: evaṃ samuppannānaṃ brāhmaṇa bhogānaṃ cattāri āyamukhāni honti
an8.55:8.2: naitthīdhutto nasurādhutto naakkhadhutto kalyāṇamitto kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇasampavaṅko
an8.55:8.3: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇa mahato taḷākassa cattāri ceva āyamukhāni cattāri ca apāyamukhāni tassa puriso yāni ceva āyamukhāni tāni vivareyya yāni ca apāyamukhāni tāni pidaheyya devo ca sammā dhāraṃ anuppaveccheyya evañhi tassa brāhmaṇa mahato taḷākassa vuḍḍhi yeva pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni
an8.55:8.4: evameva kho brāhmaṇa evaṃ samuppannānaṃ bhogānaṃ cattāri āyamukhāni honti
an8.55:9.1: ime kho brāhmaṇa cattāro dhammā kulaputtassa diṭṭhadhammahitāya saṃvattanti diṭṭhadhammasukhāya.
an8.55:10.1: cattārome brāhmaṇa dhammā kulaputtassa samparāyahitāya saṃvattanti samparāyasukhāya.
an8.55:10.5: idha brāhmaṇa kulaputto saddho hoti saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ
an8.55:10.6: itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti
an8.55:11.2: idha brāhmaṇa kulaputto pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti …pe… surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti
an8.55:12.2: idha brāhmaṇa kulaputto vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati muttacāgo payatapāṇi vossaggarato yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato
an8.55:13.2: idha brāhmaṇa kulaputto paññavā hoti …pe… sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā
an8.55:14.1: ime kho brāhmaṇa cattāro dhammā kulaputtassa samparāyahitāya saṃvattanti samparāyasukhāyāti.
